rationale: Describes mobile backhaul and signaling solutions plus managed call verification addressing spoofed, robocall, fraudulent, and malicious calls; the described function is telecom signaling and call verification, with no stated AI method.
evidence_spans: Sevis Systems is a leading provider of mobile backhaul and enhanced signaling solutions to mobile and fixed line network operators.
Sevis' managed call verification services deliver improved customer experiences, improved operational efficiencies and new revenue generating opportunities.
